ctaText: Start with your business. Shape the customer experience around the people who visit it.

Keep a digital loyalty card in Google Wallet on supported devices. Saving the card requires a valid provider link issued for the customer.

Display your Facebook link on the Customer Page so visitors can open your business profile. Automatic campaign publishing is not confirmed.

comparisonNote: A check marks a listed feature. A dash means availability is not confirmed in the catalog.
pricingFaq: These are the current display prices. Production pricing, availability and access are confirmed by the business plan catalog and billing flow.
Does choosing a plan activate my account?
No. Plan selection is a step in setup. Payment or trial activation must be confirmed before access is activated.
Does “not specified” mean a feature is excluded?
No. The current catalog does not define every entitlement. Check the confirmed plan details before choosing.
